agent_final_SQL.text:
with source_data as (
    select * from raw.tiktok_advertiser_data
)
select
        'tiktok_ads' as source_relation,
        cast("ID" as VARCHAR) as advertiser_id,
        cast("ADDRESS" as VARCHAR) as address,
        try_cast(nullif(trim("BALANCE"), '') as DOUBLE) as balance,
        cast("COMPANY" as VARCHAR) as company,
        cast("CONTACTER" as VARCHAR) as contacter,
        cast("COUNTRY" as VARCHAR) as country,
        cast("CURRENCY" as VARCHAR) as currency,
        cast("DESCRIPTION" as VARCHAR) as description,
        case when regexp_matches(lower(trim("EMAIL")), '^[a-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-z0-9-]+(\.[a-z0-9-]+)*\.[a-z]{2,}$') then lower(trim("EMAIL")) else null end as email,
        cast("INDUSTRY" as VARCHAR) as industry,
        cast("LANGUAGE" as VARCHAR) as language,
        case when length(trim("NAME")) between 3 and 100 and regexp_matches(trim("NAME"), '^[A-Za-z0-9 ]+$') then trim("NAME") else null end as advertiser_name,
        case when regexp_matches(regexp_replace(trim("CELLPHONE_NUMBER"), '[^0-9+]', '', 'g'), '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$') then regexp_replace(trim("CELLPHONE_NUMBER"), '[^0-9+]', '', 'g') else null end as cellphone_number,
        cast("TELEPHONE_NUMBER" as VARCHAR) as telephone_number,
        cast("TIMEZONE" as VARCHAR) as timezone
from source_data

    description,
    -- email normalization and validation
    case

    -- cellphone cleaning and validation (E.164)
    case
      when "CELLPHONE_NUMBER" is not null then regexp_replace("CELLPHONE_NUMBER", '[^0-9+]', '')

'stg_tiktok_ads__campaign_history':('tiktok_campaign_history_data',{}),
'stg_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history':('tiktok_adgroup_history_data',{'ad_group_id':'ADGROUP_ID','interest_category':'INTEREST_CATEGORY_V_2','ad_group_name':'ADGROUP_NAME'}),

'stg_tiktok_ads__ad_report_hourly':('tiktok_ad_report_hourly_data',{}),

'stg_tiktok_ads__campaign_report_hourly':('tiktok_campaign_report_hourly_data',{}),
'stg_tiktok_ads__campaign_country_report':('tiktok_campaign_country_report_data',{}),
}
# list field indices for malformed single-column source records
single_headers={
 'tiktok_campaign_history_data':'CAMPAIGN_ID,UPDATED_AT,ADVERTISER_ID,CAMPAIGN_NAME,CAMPAIGN_TYPE,BUDGET,BUDGET_MODE,OPERATION_STATUS,OBJECTIVE_TYPE,IS_NEW_STRUCTURE,SPLIT_TEST_VARIABLE,CREATE_TIME,_FIVETRAN_SYNCED',

 'tiktok_adgroup_history_data':'ADGROUP_ID,UPDATED_AT,ADVERTISER_ID,CAMPAIGN_ID,CREATE_TIME,ADGROUP_NAME,PLACEMENT_TYPE,PROFILE_IMAGE,LANDING_PAGE_URL,DISPLAY_NAME,APP_TYPE,APP_DOWNLOAD_URL,APP_NAME,OPTIMIZATION_EVENT,SECONDARY_OPTIMIZATION_EVENT,CREATIVE_MATERIAL_MODE,AUDIENCE_TYPE,GENDER,MIN_ANDROID_VERSION,MIN_IOS_VERSION,BUDGET_MODE,SCHEDULE_TYPE,DAYPARTING,OPTIMIZATION_GOAL,CPV_VIDEO_DURATION,PACING,BILLING_EVENT,BID_TYPE,DEEP_BID_TYPE,IMPRESSION_TRACKING_URL,CLICK_TRACKING_URL,SECONDARY_STATUS,OPERATION_STATUS,STATISTIC_TYPE,VIDEO_DOWNLOAD,OPEN_URL,OPEN_URL_TYPE,FALLBACK_TYPE,BUDGET,BID_PRICE,CONVERSION_BID_PRICE,DEEP_CPA_BID,SCHEDULE_START_TIME,SCHEDULE_END_TIME,APP_ID,PIXEL_ID,INVENTORY_FILTER_ENABLED,IS_HFSS,IS_NEW_STRUCTURE,CATEGORY,IS_COMMENT_DISABLE,SKIP_LEARNING_PHASE,FREQUENCY,FREQUENCY_SCHEDULE,ACTION_DAYS,AUDIENCE,EXCLUDED_AUDIENCE,LOCATION,INTEREST_CATEGORY_V_2,PANGLE_BLOCK_APP_LIST_ID,ACTION_CATEGORIES,PLACEMENTS,KEYWORDS,AGE_GROUPS,LANGUAGES,OPERATING_SYSTEMS,NETWORK_TYPES,CARRIERS,VIDEO_ACTIONS,PACKAGE,_FIVETRAN_SYNCED',
}
# report datasets have a single concatenated header/record col; using positions works as no comma-bearing metric values.
for tb,(src,mapping) in source_map.items():
    spec=next(x for x in yaml.safe_load(open('docs/data_contract.yaml'))['staging_contract']['tables'] if x['name']==tb)
    malformed=src in single_headers or src.endswith(('_report_hourly_data',))
    header=single_headers.get(src)
    if src.endswith('_report_hourly_data'):
        # field list from schema string
        c=__import__('duckdb').connect('tiktok_ads_start.duckdb',read_only=True)
        header=c.execute(f"select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='raw' and table_name='{src}'").fetchone()[0]
        c.close()
    idx={name:i+1 for i,name in enumerate(header.split(','))} if header else {}
    # source aliases based actual schemas
    if src=='tiktok_advertiser_data': cols=['ID','NAME','ADDRESS','BALANCE','COMPANY','CONTACTER','COUNTRY','CURRENCY','DESCRIPTION','EMAIL','INDUSTRY','LANGUAGE','CELLPHONE_NUMBER','TELEPHONE_NUMBER','TIMEZONE']
    else: cols=[x['name'] for x in spec['columns'] if x['name']!='source_relation']
    # special names
    aliases={'advertiser_name':'NAME','status':'OPERATION_STATUS'}
    exprs=[]
    for col in spec['columns']:
        n=col['name']
        if n=='source_relation': expr="'tiktok_ads'"
        else:
            src_col=mapping.get(n,aliases.get(n,n)).upper()
            if malformed:
                ix=idx.get(src_col)
                if ix is None: raise Exception((tb,n,src_col))
                # DuckDB list indexing, raw concatenated row can have comma-containing targeting arrays;
                # selected regular fields occur before those arrays except age/languages handled as best effort split.
                raw=f"list_extract(string_split({{record}}, ','), {ix})"
                expr=raw
            else: expr=f'"{src_col}"'
            typ=col['data_type']
            if typ in ('DOUBLE','BIGINT'):
                expr=f"try_cast(nullif(trim({expr}), '') as {typ})"
                if tb.endswith(('report_hourly','campaign_country_report')):
                    expr=f"coalesce({expr}, 0)"
            elif typ=='TIMESTAMP': expr=f"try_cast(nullif(trim({expr}), '') as TIMESTAMP)"
            elif typ=='DATE': expr=f"try_cast(nullif(trim({expr}), '') as DATE)"
            elif typ=='BOOLEAN': expr=f"try_cast(nullif(trim({expr}), '') as BOOLEAN)"
            elif n=='email':
                expr=f"case when regexp_matches(lower(trim({expr})), '^[a-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{{|}}~-]+@[a-z0-9-]+(\\.[a-z0-9-]+)*\\.[a-z]{{2,}}$') then lower(trim({expr})) else null end"
            elif n=='advertiser_name':
                expr=f"case when length(trim({expr})) between 3 and 100 and regexp_matches(trim({expr}), '^[A-Za-z0-9 ]+$') then trim({expr}) else null end"
            elif n=='cellphone_number':
                expr=f"case when regexp_matches(regexp_replace(trim({expr}), '[^0-9+]', '', 'g'), '^\\+[1-9][0-9]{{7,14}}$') then regexp_replace(trim({expr}), '[^0-9+]', '', 'g') else null end"
            elif typ=='VARCHAR': expr=f"cast({expr} as VARCHAR)"
        exprs.append(f'        {expr} as {n}')
    fromexpr=f'raw.{src}'
    if malformed:
        # aliased row representation: for a one-column raw record, extract the sole field
        # If there are regular fields, columns are instead directly accessed.
        pass
    sql='with source_data as (\n    select * from '+fromexpr+'\n)\nselect\n'+',\n'.join(exprs)+'\nfrom source_data'
    if malformed:
        # source table's one column name may contain entire schema header
        c=__import__('duckdb').connect('tiktok_ads_start.duckdb',read_only=True)
        colsraw=[r[0] for r in c.execute(f"describe raw.{src}").fetchall()]; c.close()
        if len(colsraw)==1:
            rawcol='"'+colsraw[0].replace('"','""')+'"'
            sql=sql.replace('select * from '+fromexpr, f'select {rawcol} as record from {fromexpr}')
            sql=sql.replace('{record}', 'record')
        else:
            # standard columns in campaign country, full hourly uses concatenated single field
            pass
    # latest record flags calculated across parsed source rows
    if tb in ('stg_tiktok_ads__campaign_history','stg_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history','stg_tiktok_ads__ad_history'):
        key={'stg_tiktok_ads__campaign_history':'campaign_id','stg_tiktok_ads__ad_group_history':'ad_group_id','stg_tiktok_ads__ad_history':'ad_id'}[tb]
        sql='with staged as (\n'+sql+'\n), ranked as (\n    select *, max(updated_at) over (partition by source_relation, '+key+') as max_updated_at\n    from staged\n)\nselect\n    '+',\n    '.join([x['name'] for x in spec['columns'] if x['name']!='is_most_recent_record'])+',\n    (updated_at is not distinct from max_updated_at) as is_most_recent_record\nfrom ranked'
    (root/'staging'/f'{tb}.sql').write_text(sql+'\n')
